passages.p2:
Exercise 2: Give the correct prefix of the words in the following paragraph.
(Tìm tiền tố đúng của các từ trong đoạn văn sau)
Yesterday, my friends and I went for a picnic. I came up with an idea of going somewhere far from the city. Then, we four made up our mind right away. We rented a _________________ (1. VAN) and Jake volunteered to be the driver. We all had an _______________ ( 2. BEAT) mood for this unexpected trip. Jenny was a careful girl so she had to __________ ( 3. DATE) the news, the weather and everything she could think of. Our bookworm Lily could dwell on her _______________ ( 4. ECONOMICS) text book at any time. I was sitting beside Jake, who was in an _______________ ( 5. SIZE) T-shirt and too concentrated on the road. He was so sweet that an _______________ ( 6. SPOKEN) girl like me couldn’t say anything bad to him ever. After 15 minutes of driving, we drove _______________ ( 7. HILL) to a vast area where we can put up our tents. It took US a little time to prepare and started grilling. Jenny was afraid the beef was _______________ ( 8. COOKED) and raw, but it turned out to be delicious. It would be great if trips like this were one of our _______________ ( 9. CURRICULAR) activities at school. If that happens, we will ask the principle to let US travel in a _______________ ( 10. MARINE) !
